definitions.gloss: pale, pallid, ashen, white as a sheet
definitions.explanation: Describes a face or complexion that has lost its natural color due to shock, fear, illness, or fatigue. Suggests an unhealthy or alarming degree of paleness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蒼白|そうはく}になった。
examples.english: Upon hearing the news, she turned pale.

examples.english: Seeing him pale-faced and trembling, I realized something terrible had happened.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary or formal word primarily used in written language and fiction. Describes an extreme, alarming paleness rather than simply having fair skin. Almost always refers to the face.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {蒼白|そうはく}: deathly pale (literary, dramatic)
- ⟦{青白|あおじろ}い→青白い：14652_aojiroi⟧: pale, wan (everyday adjective)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{青|さお}→真っ青：07615_massao⟧: pale with shock (colloquial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蒼白|そうはく}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a pallid face
- {蒼白|そうはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn pale/ashen
- ⟦{顔面|がんめん}→顔面：14693_ganmen⟧{蒼白|そうはく}: ashen-faced (set phrase)
